Little by little, things began to change. People around Eva often share different ideas about the study app. The experience taught Eva more than any book could. The evening news starts at seven.
The study app looked quieter than usual that evening. The e-book shelf has become an important part of daily life. Eva thanked Owen for the honest advice. For example, the fire made the front page.

Eva usually spends the weekend reading at the supermarket. On Sunday evenings, Eva reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. In fact, the puppy gave my hand a friendly lick.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Some factories underpay their workers and force long overtime hours.
Eva wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Eva keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Eva's dream job is to be a nurse.
